FLINK-33198.title: Add timestamp with local time zone support in Avro converters
FLINK-33198.description: Currently, RowDataToAvroConverters doesn't handle with LogicType TIMESTAMP_WITH_LOCAL_TIME_ZONE. We should add the corresponding conversion.

commits.message: [FLINK-33198] support local timezone timestamp logic type in AVRO
commits.author: HuangZhenQiu

FLINK-34196.title: FLIP-389 Annotate SingleThreadFetcherManager as PublicEvolving.
FLINK-34196.description:
This improvement implements [FLIP-389](https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=278465498)

This flip has 2 goals:
 * To expose the SplitFetcherManager / SingleThreadFetcheManager as Public, allowing connector developers to easily create their own threading models in the SourceReaderBase.
 * To hide the element queue from the connector developers and make SplitFetcherManager the only owner class of the queue

FLINK-34316.title: Reduce instantiation of ScanRuntimeProvider in streaming mode
FLINK-34316.description: This is pure performance optimization by avoiding an additional call to \{{ScanTableSource#getScanRuntimeProvider}} in \{{org.apache.flink.table.planner.connectors.DynamicSourceUtils#validateScanSource}}.

commits.message: [FLINK-34316] Reduce instantiation of ScanRuntimeProvider in streaming mode
commits.author: twalthr

FLINK-20090.title: Expose SlotId / SlotSharingGroup in Rest API
FLINK-20090.description:
There is no information on slot sharing exposed via the Rest API which would be useful to monitor how tasks are assigned to task slots.

We could include the SlotId in {{SubtaskExecutionAttemptDetailsInfo}} and provide a list of slots in {{TaskManagersInfo}}.

commits.message: [FLINK-20090][rest] Expose slot sharing group info in REST API
commits.author: gaborgsomogyi

FLINK-34429.title: Adding K8S Annotations to Internal Service
FLINK-34429.description:
Flink currently supports adding Annotations to the Rest Service (with the configuration key:
kubernetes.rest-service.annotations). 

New configuration key: kubernetes.internal-service.annotations should be added to allow the same functionality for the internal service. 
 
This is useful, for example, when implementing Teleport app discovery. Without special annotation to the service, Teleport floods the JobManger with errors:

 
{code:java}
2024-02-12 09:24:43,747 WARN org.apache.pekko.remote.transport.netty.NettyTransport [] - Remote connection to [/172.16.108.253:39884] failed with org.jboss.netty.handler.codec.frame.TooLongFrameException: Adjusted frame length exceeds 10485760: 369295621 - discarded 2024-02-12 09:24:43,753 ERROR org.apache.flink.runtime.blob.BlobServerConnection [] - Error while executing BLOB connection from /172.16.108.253:40954. java.io.IOException: Unknown operation 22 at org.apache.flink.runtime.blob.BlobServerConnection.run(BlobServerConnection.java:116) [flink-dist-1.18.1.jar:1.18.1]  {code}
To avoid these we need to add [special Annotations|https://github.com/gravitational/teleport/blob/master/rfd/0135-kube-apps-discovery.md#annotations] to the internal service.
